Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Malaga hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 10 of the 15 Malaga hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, the hotel's own site at 2, Clicktrip.com at 1, Mariposa Hotel Malaga at 1 and Trip.com at 1. These are the Malaga rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 10 of the 14 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, the hotel's own site at 2, Clicktrip.com at 1, Mariposa Hotel Malaga at 1 and Trip.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 4, no site was 5% or more below it. Taxes and fees at Malaga hotels

At the 10 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($11 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Futurotel Malagueta to 11% at B&B HOTEL Málaga Centro. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
